integration.sandboxNote: Real WAWU_ID_INTERNAL_SERVICE_KEY not available in this sandbox. Build agent implements the real JWKS-verification guard (this part is fully testable locally against a mock JWKS endpoint standing in for WAWU ID) plus the real outbound internal-API client behind an interface, with a mock adapter for tests. Live connectivity to the production WAWU ID service is an explicit open risk for Phase 8 to state plainly.

reads.note: Decoded from the Bearer JWT on every authenticated request via RS256 + JWKS (cached 24h). This backend never stores name/email/phone as its own source of truth — these fields pass through from the token for display/denormalization only where a resource genuinely needs a snapshot (e.g. Purchase.buyerName for a receipt), never as an editable local copy.

actions.name: elevateVerificationTier
actions.note: PATCH /internal/users/:userId/verification-tier on WAWU ID, header X-Service-Key. Called by this backend's own verification-submission review workflow when a manual reviewer approves a badge-ladder application. Elevate-only (WAWU ID's own semantics, never a downgrade from this call).

note: This is infrastructure (a Nest guard + strategy + a small WawuIdClient service in src/common/), not a resource module with its own controller/CRUD endpoints. The Phase 4 schema/pre-step agent builds the JWT verification guard; a later Phase-5 'verification' resource build agent builds the elevateVerificationTier call site as part of its own review-approval endpoint.
